alt: Three boxes: Standing still (yes, until you move), Aiming (yes, with guns that have sights), Driving (only with the phone out).

data.title: Where first-person works

cards.title: Standing still
cards.body: Yes. Walk and it switches off.

cards.title: Aiming
cards.body: Yes, with guns that have sights.

cards.title: Driving
cards.body: Only while your phone is out.

data.note: No full first-person mode like GTA 5 (VGC, PowerPyx, Insider Gaming, 18 Nov 2026).
